description: This PHP file defines a database migration class for version 4.1.1 of the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods to modify the database schema, such as dropping foreign keys, dropping and adding primary keys, and altering columns in a specific table.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class representing a database schema migration for version 4.1.1 of OrangeHRM, extending the AbstractMigration. Contains methods to modify database schema during upgrade.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the schema changes for this migration: disables constraints, drops foreign keys, drops and modifies primary key, adds a new column, and enables constraints.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '4.1.1'.
